longDescription: See what is playing and control Windows audio directly from your Ulanzi D200. Now Playing shows artwork, track details, playback state, and progress, with a configurable accent color for the play/pause badge and filled progress bar. Build a four-key artwork mosaic and optionally add circular action badges in each tile's outer corner, with white state-aware glyphs for transport or audio controls; choose None to keep a tile display-only. Use Large Now Playing on the center display, dedicated transport keys, circular track progress, and per-key controls for system volume or active application audio. Everything runs locally on Windows with no cloud service or account. The plugin includes and supervises its own embedded companion bridge, so no separate companion installation is required.
